positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Leader, Instrument Research & Development
Led team of firmware engineers responsible for full product life-cycle software development over multiple product lines.

•	Developed prototype spectrometer software running on TI Sitara 3358 (ARM-beaglebone).  Software design was split between a Linux user application level for processing and real-time assembly software collecting data on 2 PRU cores.
•	Led firmware design and development of a coronary artery imaging device consisting of 3 embedded DSP processors, stepper and servo motors & FPGA interface.
•	Designed firmware, low level device drivers and .NET GUI for a Xilinx FPGA high speed data acquisition board over multi-lane PCIe.
•	Provided customers with documented API interfaces from products to Labview, Matlab, .NET, activeX, C++
•	Led software team in the development of a handheld substance identification Raman spectrometer including .NET GUI.
•	Streamlined software release procedures and implemented new source control system and bug tracking software with corresponding documentation for ISO. 
•	Collaborated with marketing team to develop long range software plans and goals for spectrometer and OCT imaging product lines.
•	Supportive and collaborative interactions with application scientists and end users to improve software reliability and customer satisfaction for spectrometer and OCT product lines.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Staff Software Engineer, Instrument Research & Development
Designed, developed and documented software across the complete Affymetrix microarray instrumentation product line.

•	Led team of five software engineers for one year during development of an automated GeneChip® cartridge loading system for the GeneChip Scanner 3000.  Developed windows level software, embedded VxWorks software and embedded microcontroller software and the required interfaces among these components.  Project lead role required code development, supervision of software team, and direct interaction with marketing and manufacturing to ensure system performed according to corporate goals.  The GeneChip® Scanner 3000 with AutoLoader was the winner of the 2004 R&D 100 Award and is FDA 510(k) compliant.
•	Developed embedded VxWorks software for the GeneChip® Scanner 3000, the first GeneChip® scanner developed by Affymetrix.  Developed code for three system modules including image acquisition and real time processing of image data.  ISO level documentation was required for all system modules including SRS documents and design documents including PSPECS and data flow diagrams.  All modules required individual test routines
•	Developed and released windows software for a high throughput microarray plate scanner.  This software included a user interface and a separate COM based scan engine written in Visual Studio C++.  Developed a tool for users to create and edit configuration files in C#.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Instrument Research & Development
Developed embedded software for a DNA microarray slide scanner.  

•	Designed and developed software for a DNA microarray scanner utilizing a TI DSP chip controller.  Software included high speed data collection and motor drivers.  This software included a novel, patentable method for correction of laser power fluctuations while scanning allowing for a reduction in instrument developments costs.
•	Designed software with Rational Rose CASE tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Technical team leader responsible for creating, designing and developing software for chemical analytical instruments including a novel high speed gas chromatograph and explosive detection systems.  The software included a real time multitasking control system of the instrument as well as a user interface that ran on a PC.

•	Designed and developed a gas chromatograph instrument control and scientific analysis package.  This instrument won the ‘Best New Product’ award at PITTCON 1996.
•	Created software for High Speed GC-Mass Spectrometer.  
•	Developed strategy of reusable software for use across multiple projects resulting in savings of two programmers.
•	Designed and wrote graphical 2D and 3D user interfaces.
•	Wrote TCP/IP applications as an integral component of systems.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software and documentation as part of R&D to control pharmaceutical robot systems

•	Automated the process of customizing robotic software for new robotic installations.  This resulted in 50% programming time savings.
•	Customized robot systems to satisfy customer requirements.
•	Designed Microsoft Windows interfaces for robotic systems.
•	Trained customers on robotic products.
